Introduction

NaKyoung is a South Korean dancer, rapper, and singer under MODHAUS.

NaKyoung was introduced as the seventh member of the girl group tripleS under MODHAUS on August 22, 2022. She first debuted with the sub-unit Acid Angel from Asia on October 28, 2022, with the mini album "ACCESS". With their first ten revealed members, tripleS debuted on February 13, 2023, with the mini album "ASSEMBLE".

As a member of tripleS, NaKyoung was placed in the sub-units Acid Angel from Asia, ACID EYES, EVOLution, Visionary Vision, and Neptune.
